rubric_content.text_property: Agent calls list_windows_tool, analyze_collision_tool for each window, then save_collision_output_tool.
All available windows are processed (010 and 011 in the test scenario).
The agent output is valid JSON with required keys: windows_analyzed (int), collisions_detected (int or bool), temporal_analysis (object), summary_insights (list). No prose commentary.
windows_analyzed reflects both windows in the test scenario (2 windows).
summary_insights contains at least one collision-related insight derived from the analyses.
